title: Components in arrays
description:
Store components in separate arrays and run systems over them.

```
entities: 3 with Position, 2 with Velocity
movement system: updated 2 entities
entity 1 has no velocity -> did not move
destroy entity 0 -> its components removed
```
hints: Loop over the smaller map (velocities) and look the entity up in the other (lesson 10.03).
A sparse set (dense array plus an index map) keeps components packed in memory, which is faster to loop over.
requirements: Entities are ids; each component type lives in its own `std::unordered_map<Entity, Component>` (or a sparse set for a bonus).
A movement system that handles entities with both Position and Velocity.
Destroying an entity removes all its components.
stretch: Make a generic `ComponentStore<T>` so adding a component type is one line.
